{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|[Panaka] ordered us to raid the Penladen detention camp, which we were only too happy to do. We hit those droids hard and took down the fence generator, and when it went down the Naboo did the rest. Never thought I'd see Theed gentry tearing the arms off clankers in a rage, but that's what happened.|Pars Varqom's memoirs|<ref name="WarfareCut6">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Penladen detention camp''' in [[Penladen Hills]] was one of several [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] prison camps built for the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. After the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|raid on Theed]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] encharged six [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] with liberating the camp. The Naboo forces assaulted the camp and took down the generator, while the captive citizens helped the guards by destroying the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] with their bare hands.<ref name="WarfareCut6" />

Retired Palace Guard [[Pars Varqom]] later recalled that the sight of the camp was "terrible," noting that battle droids were programmed to kill and thus had no idea of how to take care of people. Sickness and starvation ensued. Varqom compared the inmates' situation with that of penned [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]].<ref name="WarfareCut6" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], writer of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', eventually cut any mentioning of Penladen detention camp in the final product. The camp was later made [[canon]]ical in the [[StarWars.com]] blog post [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 6 — Showdown at Naboo'']].<ref name="WarfareCut6" />
